text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, that run was truly a breath of fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: As I ran down the track, I felt as if I'd become an invigorating breeze!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: I want that wind to blow even harder!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that. In that case, I'll make sure I win next time as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let's savor this refreshing breeze together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll need to train even harder if we're to enjoy this fresh breeze again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on your continued support.
